list.title: module:GridItem.onTextureManagerStateChanged
list.description: Fires when textureManagerState changes (init → active, active → hidden, etc.)

list.title: module:GridItem.reloadGridTexture
list.description: Restores poster URI from cache when the cell scrolls back on screen. The backdrop will show briefly while the image reloads from Roku's HTTP cache.

list.title: module:GridItem.renderGenreTile
list.description: Renders a "View All [Genre]" action tile: themed backdrop + centered genre label, no poster image. The below-tile item title is hidden — the tile's own centered label already names the genre, and the row's genre header sits directly above it, so a third copy is redundant. cachedPosterUri is cleared so texture management skips this cell.

list.title: module:GridItem.renderLoadingCell
list.description:
Renders a skeleton cell: themed backdrop only, no poster, title or tile.

The poster is hidden rather than left with an empty uri so the cell reads as "waiting" instead of as a failed image — JRPlaceholder's typed glyph is the missing artwork signal, and a row that simply hasn't loaded yet has not failed at anything. cachedPosterUri is cleared so texture management skips this cell.

The spinner costs render-thread time (measured ~100 ms across an 8-genre load) but that cost is bounded by the VIEWPORT, not by genre count — the RowList lays out ~3 rows and recycles GridItem cells, so a 40-genre library has no more spinners on screen than an 8-genre one. The wait it covers, by contrast, grows linearly with genre count and with server latency. So it gets relatively cheaper exactly where it matters most.

list.title: module:GridItem.renderMediaItem
list.description: Renders a standard media item: poster image with the JRPlaceholder fallback state machine and texture management.

list.title: module:GridItem.resetPlaceholderToLoading
list.description: Reset the JRPlaceholder to loading state (themed backdrop visible, no glyph). Used by the initial-load branches in renderMediaItem and by the texture unload paths so off-screen / unloaded cells don't carry a stale failure-state glyph back into view when they reload.

list.title: module:GridItem.resolveGridViewConfig
list.description: Resolves the owning BaseGridView and reads its display/title config. Walks up the node tree to the first ancestor exposing gridTitles rather than assuming a fixed depth: the MarkupGrid puts cells 2 levels below BaseGridView, but the genre RowList nests them deeper. The old fixed GetParent().GetParent() walk missed BaseGridView for RowList cells, so genre tiles silently fell back to scaleToZoom (cropping posters the presenter intended as scaleToFit) and an empty gridTitles (no titles ever). Idempotent — caches m.gridView on first success.

list.title: module:GridItem.resolveLoadDisplayMode
list.description: Picks the poster scaling mode. Music posters are square art that must not be cropped; everything else uses the grid's configured display mode (default scaleToZoom).

list.title: module:GridItem.setPosterRect
list.description: Positions/sizes the placeholder, poster, and genre backdrop to the same rect.

list.title: module:GridItem.setupGridTextureObserver
list.description: One-time setup: observes loadedRowRange and textureManagerState on the MarkupGrid's content root. The content root is the direct parent of itemContent in the content tree (flat model, unlike RowList's 2-level hierarchy): contentRoot → itemNode (itemContent) Called from onItemContentChanged. Skips if already connected.

list.title: module:GridItem.shouldLoadGridTexture
list.description: Determines whether this cell should load its poster during initial render. Mirrors evaluateGridTextureState logic: managed rows trust buffer logic, outside rows trust renderTracking.

list.title: module:GridItem.showPlaceholder
list.description: Flip the placeholder into failure state with a type-appropriate glyph, then clear the poster URI so the glyph isn't covered by a stale broken image. itemType="" puts JRPlaceholder in loading state (backdrop only, no glyph); resolveItemPlaceholderType returns "" only for invalid/typeless items, so valid items always end up here with a typed glyph or the Folder fallback.

list.title: module:GridItem.unloadGridTexture
list.description: Clears poster URI to release texture memory when the cell is off-screen. Items with no real image (cachedPosterUri = "") are skipped — they already show a lightweight local placeholder that costs negligible texture memory.

list.title: module:GridItem.updateLayout
list.description: Sizes and positions every child to the current cell dimensions. The focus slot is rowItemSize/itemSize; the poster fills it at POSTER_TOP_OFFSET so the poster overflows the slot bottom and the focus border (drawn behind it) reads with a top margin and no overlap. The title sits below at POSTER_TOP_OFFSET + h + TITLE_GAP — kept OUTSIDE the focus border because the container sets rowHeights/itemSize taller than the slot (the focus border pins to the slot, not the cell's full bounding box).

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase
list.description: Constructor - view is set later via onInit()

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#clearPresentationInfo
list.description: Clears/hides the presentation info display

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#configureLoadTask
list.description: Configures the LoadItemsTask2 query for data loading

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#createInfoNodes
list.description: Creates presenter-specific info nodes in the presentationInfo group Called during onInit() if presenter needs custom info display

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#currentView
list.description:
The view mode the grid is currently showing, or "" when it cannot be read.

getOptions() receives the parent item but not the view, and some of its lists depend on which view is up (a Collections view sorts BoxSets, not movies), so the view is read back off the host component. BaseGridView keeps currentView in step with its own m.view — it sets it in loadInitialItems before SetUpOptions runs, and again in optionsClosed before the reload — so this is the same string the load is using.

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#getBackdropMode
list.description: Returns the backdrop mode for this presenter

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#getGridConfig
list.description: Returns grid layout configuration for the specified view mode

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#getItemType
list.description: Returns the item type(s) to load

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#getOptions
list.description: Returns the options configuration for ItemGridOptions

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#loadFilters
list.description: Load dynamic filter options (Genres, Years, Ratings) from the Jellyfin API. Call from configureLoadTask() in subclasses that need dynamic filters. Delegates the fetch to the host component (BaseGridView.loadFilters) via callFunc so it runs in component-m context, where fetchAsync + auto-abandon work — a presenter is a class, not a component, so the auto-abandon plugin can't inject into it (Phase-4 collapse of GetFiltersTask; see docs/dev/promises.md). Results arrive via onFiltersLoaded(). Set by refreshFilters() when the panel opens.

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#onDestroy
list.description: Called when presenter is being destroyed Override to clean up resources, stop tasks, unobserve fields Always call super.onDestroy() at the end of overrides

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#onFiltersLoaded
list.description: Called when filters are delivered by the host component's promise (BaseGridView.loadFilters). Caches the result in m.apiFilters and shows a toast on failure.

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#onInit
list.description: Called after presenter is attached to BaseGridView Stores view reference and creates shared task nodes Override in subclass but call super.onInit(view) first

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#onItemFocused
list.description: Called when an item receives focus Override to update presentation info display

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#onOptionsClosed
list.description: Called when options dialog is closed Override to handle presenter-specific option changes

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#refreshFilters
list.description:
refreshFilters: Revalidate the cached filter lists in the background.

Called when the options panel OPENS, which is the only moment the lists are actually looked at — so freshness is bought exactly where it is spent, and a session that never opens the panel pays for one load instead of one per query build.

Deliberately NOT rendered into the open panel. BaseGridView.SetUpOptions() has already read m.apiFilters by the time this answers, and re-running it would reassign the panel's content and reset checkedItem — categories would appear and shift focus under a cursor already moving through the list. The refreshed lists show on the NEXT open, which is the stale-while-revalidate contract and the reason no TTL is needed.

It also retries a previous failure: a failed load never marks the cache populated, so the panel that needs those categories is what asks for them again.

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#serverVersion
list.description:
The connected server's version string, or "" when it cannot be read.

Presenters run on the render thread, where m.global is owned locally and free to touch (2.0 µs against 93 µs from a Task — docs/architecture/threading.md). The guards are for the unit suites, which construct a presenter against a stand-in view with no global at all, and textOrEmpty() rather than toString() because toString() falls through to Str() and FAULTS on Invalid.

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#shouldShowPresentationInfo
list.description: Returns whether to show presentation info panel for the view mode

list.title: module:GridPresenterBase.GridPresenterBase#showToast
list.description: Show a toast notification via the scene-level Toast component. Safe to call from presenter classes (routes through view's scene reference).

list.title: module:HexKeyboard.onKeyGridRendered
list.description: Position reset button below the keyboard grid, aligned to right edge

list.title: module:Home.buildOptionsMenu
list.description: Build the options side-panel (search / settings / change user / change server / sign out). The buttons are observed by Home itself; onSidePanelOption routes them — navigation actions go through the router, session actions up to main.bs.

list.title: module:Home.checkServerCapabilities
list.description:
checkServerCapabilities: Record which server plugins are installed, once per sign-in. See source/utils/serverCapabilities.bs for the pattern.

Re-checked even when an answer is already held: Home is torn down on every sign-out and mounted fresh on sign-in, so this is what lets a plugin the admin installed since the last check show up without restarting the app. A failed check never overwrites a known answer (recordSubtitleProviderStatus stores only definite ones).

Warms the answer only: a detail screen that finds it still unknown asks itself, so nothing waits on this reply and a failure here costs nothing.

list.title: module:Home.destroyActiveContent
list.description: Destroys the currently active tab content and removes it from the scene

list.title: module:Home.getActiveRows
list.description: Returns the currently active row list

list.title: module:Home.getRokuIps
list.description: Collect this device's LAN IP addresses for the cold-launch pairing report (#668): the values of roDeviceInfo.GetIPAddrs() ({ : }). The device call is kept here (out of the pure remoteProtocol module); remoteProtocol.buildPairRequest sanitizes/dedupes the list.

list.title: module:Home.handleFocus
list.description: Router focus hook (overrides JRScreen.handleFocus). The router asks the resuming view to take focus right after onViewResume -> onScreenShown. The base implementation uses restoreFocus(m.top), which focuses a Home row and clobbers the overhang-icon (gear/search) focus onScreenShown just set. Re-run Home's overhang-aware restore so the gear stays focused on return (matching prod), then consume the one-shot overhang target.

list.title: module:Home.handleHomeMenuAction
list.description: Route a Home menu action. Navigation actions resolve through the router on the render thread; session-ending actions (change user/server, sign out) are emitted as userMenuAction for main.bs, which tears down the routed Home and re-enters the login flow IN PLACE via reenterLogin (see handleMenuAction).

list.title: module:Home.initVoiceBox
list.description: initVoiceBox: One-time voice setup in init() — matches BaseGridView's pattern. Sets voiceEnabled=true ONCE and never sets it back to false. The firmware silently manages voiceEnabled when other screens claim voice routing. Only active is toggled on screen show/hide.

list.title: module:Home.loadLibraries
list.description: Kicks off the home-row library load. Called from onScreenShown on first run (the router mounts Home, so this is no longer triggered externally by main.bs).

list.title: module:Home.onCloseSidePanel
list.description: Options side-panel closed without a selection — restore focus to content.

list.title: module:Home.onDestroy
list.description: onDestroy: Full teardown releasing all resources before component removal Called automatically via JRScreen.beforeViewClose when sgRouter permanently closes this view.

list.title: module:Home.onIconFocusReturn
list.description: Overhang icon signals DOWN was pressed — return focus to active content

list.title: module:Home.onOverhangIconAction
list.description: Overhang icon (search/settings) was pressed — proxy to Home's interface for Main.bs. Saves the focused icon for focus restoration on return, then moves focus to Home group BEFORE firing the action. This ensures the router's suspend saves a focus inside Home's tree. We focus m.top (not activeContent) to avoid a visible focus jump to the row list before the screen transition.

list.title: module:Home.onQuickPlayLaunch
list.description: Forward a fallen-through item tap to the playback launcher.

list.title: module:Home.onQuickPlayNode
list.description: Proxy quickPlayNode from whichever row list fires it. Must pass through invalid clears so Home.quickPlayNode doesn't retain a stale value that re-fires the m.port observer on screen restoration.

list.title: module:Home.onRowItemSelected
list.description: A row item was selected — navigate to its route, passing the rich content node as context (so details/library self-load without a re-fetch). Items that aren't view navigation (e.g. Chapter) fall through to the playback path via quickPlayNode.

list.title: module:Home.onScreenHidden
list.description: JRScreen hook called when the screen is hidden by the screen manager

list.title: module:Home.onScreenShown
list.description: JRScreen hook called when the screen is displayed by the screen manager

list.title: module:Home.onSidePanelOption
list.description: Options side-panel button pressed — close the panel, then route the action.

list.title: module:Home.onTabBarFocusReturn
list.description: Tab bar signals DOWN was pressed — return focus to active content

list.title: module:Home.onTabChanged
list.description: Called when selectedTabId changes (proxied back from the overhang tab bar by JRScene's overhang controller). Destroys the old tab's content and creates the new tab's content.

list.title: module:Home.onUserDropdownFocusReturn
list.description: User dropdown signals DOWN was pressed — return focus to active content

list.title: module:Home.onUserMenuAction
list.description: User dropdown menu item was selected — proxy to Home's interface for Main.bs. Saves the dropdown so onScreenShown can restore focus when the user returns, then moves focus into Home's tree so the router's suspend saves a focus that back-from-route can restore.

list.title: module:Home.onVoiceSearch
list.description: onVoiceSearch: Fires when voice input is captured by the hidden VoiceTextEditBox. Signals Main.bs to open SearchResults with the spoken query pre-populated.

list.title: module:Home.restoreHomeFocus
list.description:
Restore Home's focus, OVERHANG-ICON-AWARE. Priority:

  1. The overhang element that triggered the last navigation (gear / search / dropdown). These live in the persistent overhang — a child of JRScene, NOT of Home — so they can't be reached via m.top.lastFocus.
  2. Home's own lastFocus (normal in-group restoration), skipping the hidden voice box.
  3. Active content, then the Home group. Called by BOTH onScreenShown and handleFocus: the router invokes handleFocus right after onScreenShown, and its base restoreFocus(m.top) would otherwise override the overhang-icon focus with a Home row (the "gear focus removed on return to Home" regression). Does NOT clear the one-shot m.lastOverhangFocus — handleFocus clears it once the resume's focus restore is complete.

list.title: module:HomeRows.applyPendingRowRemovals
list.description: applyPendingRowRemovals: Drop the rows whose libraries returned nothing, queued during a run so the row list and the geometry arrays never disagree mid-load. Looked up by sectionId rather than a stored index — each removal shifts the ones after it.

list.title: module:HomeRows.buildSectionPlan
list.description: buildSectionPlan: Reads homeSection0-6 settings, returns ordered array of sections to display

list.title: module:HomeRows.checkVisibleRowsFilled
list.description:
checkVisibleRowsFilled: Mark Home painted once every row in the visible span has landed.

Waits for the final row layout (m.initialLoadComplete): before the libraries answer, the latest-media rows are not in the list yet, so the span would describe rows that are about to be pushed down. Called after every resolve and after every structural change that can shift rows into the span. The decision itself is homeScreenLoad.visibleRowsResolved.

list.title: module:HomeRows.createSkeletonRow
list.description: createSkeletonRow: Creates a single empty HomeRow with correct title, sectionId, and cursorSize. Adds a single placeholder child node so the RowList renders the row.

list.title: module:HomeRows.createSkeletonRows
list.description: createSkeletonRows: Creates empty HomeRow nodes for all planned sections except latestmedia. Each skeleton row gets a single placeholder child so the RowList renders the row label and a loading indicator at the correct slot size.

list.title: module:HomeRows.discardRowBatch
list.description:
discardRowBatch: Drop pending row work without paying for it.

Teardown only. setRowItemSize() is the most expensive call in this file (~90-200 ms, nearly all of it the RowList re-measuring every cell against the new rowItemSize) and it runs on the render thread — so flushing a batch for a node that is about to be released spends that on geometry nobody will see. Clearing the state first makes resetLatestRowsRun's applyPendingRowRemovals + flushRowSizes no-op.

WHEN this is reached, because the obvious answer is wrong: NOT on navigating away from Home. Home is SUSPENDED rather than destroyed by the router (see startLatestMediaLoads, which relies on that). HomeRows.onDestroy comes from Home.destroyActiveContent() — a tab switch to Favorites — and from Home.onDestroy when sgRouter permanently closes the view. So the way to force a run in flight into this path is to switch tabs during a Home load.

list.title: module:HomeRows.findInsertIndexForSection
list.description: findInsertIndexForSection: Determines the correct content index for a section that needs to be inserted. Uses the section plan ordering to maintain row order.

list.title: module:HomeRows.findLatestMediaInsertIndex
list.description: findLatestMediaInsertIndex: Determines the correct content index for latestmedia rows based on the section plan ordering.

list.title: module:HomeRows.findRowBySectionId
list.description: findRowBySectionId: Find a row in content by its sectionId field

list.title: module:HomeRows.flushRowSizes
list.description: flushRowSizes: Recompute if a structural change is still pending. No-op otherwise, so it is safe to call unconditionally at a batch boundary.

list.title: module:HomeRows.getItemAtIndices
list.description: Gets an item from content at specified row and item indices Performs all necessary bounds checking and validation

list.title: module:HomeRows.getRowConfigForSection
list.description: getRowConfigForSection: Returns title and slotSize for a sectionId. Used when inserting a row that was previously removed (no skeleton exists).

list.title: module:HomeRows.getSectionIdForType
list.description: getSectionIdForType: Maps a section type string to its sectionId

list.title: module:HomeRows.insertLatestMediaSkeletons
list.description: insertLatestMediaSkeletons: Creates skeleton rows for each non-excluded library and inserts them at the correct position in the content node.

list.title: module:HomeRows.loadLibraries
list.description: loadLibraries: Entry point called by Home.bs via callFunc. Builds ordered section plan, creates skeleton rows, then fires data tasks.

list.title: module:HomeRows.logRowRemoved
list.description:
logRowRemoved: Publish an immediate row removal AT THE INSTANT IT HAPPENS.

Its own line and its own moment, because sizeRemove cannot answer the question it was built for: those counters are zeroed at run start and read at run end, so a removal landing outside that window increments nothing anybody reports — and on this server the removal is unconditional, which makes sizeRemove a race outcome rather than an occurrence count. Why it is unconditional is a four-step chain through session.bs, createSkeletonRow, startParallelLoads and removalIsDeferrable; it is written out once, in docs/dev/home-first-paint-performance.md ("row removed"), rather than twice.

What a change to this function has to preserve:

  • The ORDINAL on at, and that it is per HomeRows INSTANCE. assembleSamples closes a sample when a line it already holds repeats, so a second immediate removal in one launch splits that launch across two samples. The ordinal is what makes the split visible in the record instead of a silent short read.
  • BOTH halves of cells, and that both are signed. loadsStarted is the discriminator and binds is the postcondition on it — loadsStarted 0 is what a genuinely early removal prints AND what a probe reading a counter-less root would print, so dropping binds makes those one reading. The -1 guard cannot fire in HomeRows today (init creates m.top.content and attaches the counters to that same node in the same init), but it is nearly free and the alternative to printing it is dropping the line, which reads as "no removal happened" — the one wrong answer.
  • The argument COUNT. roku-log faults at RUNTIME (&hf1, straight into the debugger) past nine call-site arguments once the BSC plugin has spent one on the injected pkg path. Three label/value pairs with two composed values sits a pair clear of that; nine is legal and this line would fit, but a probe whose overflow costs a whole device run is not worth writing at the ceiling.

list.title: module:HomeRows.onDestroy
list.description: onDestroy: Full teardown releasing all resources before component removal Called by Home.bs onDestroy() before nulling the homeRows reference

list.title: module:HomeRows.onItemFocused
list.description: Observer for rowItemFocused field - delegates to updateBackdropForFocusedItem

list.title: module:HomeRows.onLatestRowsReady
list.description: onLatestRowsReady: Drains all unprocessed result children from the orchestrator. Each wake may cover several results — wake events can coalesce, the children can't.

list.title: module:HomeRows.onLibrariesLoaded
list.description: onLibrariesLoaded: Handler when LoadLibrariesTask returns data. Populates the library row, creates latestmedia skeleton rows, then fires latest tasks.

list.title: module:HomeRows.onProgramsExpired
list.description: Fires when JRRowList's progress tick detects at least one expired Program or Recording. Re-runs the On Now and/or Active Recordings loads to pull fresh data. Loading guards debounce repeated expiry signals while a load is already in flight, and section plan checks avoid wasted requests when the user has disabled the relevant sections.

list.title: module:HomeRows.onSectionPopulated
list.description: onSectionPopulated: Called after each section is populated with data. Signals AppLaunchComplete after 2 sections have loaded.

list.title: module:HomeRows.populateLibraryRow
list.description: populateLibraryRow: Fills the library row with filtered library items. Uses populateRowFromData for consistent in-place update behavior.

list.title: module:HomeRows.populateRowFromData
list.description: populateRowFromData: Unified row population logic used by all update callbacks. Updates the children of the existing row node in place to avoid RowList re-layout and focus disruption. Removes the row if data is empty. If the row doesn't exist but data is available (e.g., a previously empty section now has content on refresh), creates and inserts the row at the correct position.

list.title: module:HomeRows.removeRowAtIndex
list.description:
removeRowAtIndex: Removes a row at the given index and recalculates sizes

Recomputes IMMEDIATELY, batch or no batch. This path is only reached for a row the current run does not own (latestRows.removalIsDeferrable said no), so nothing later is going to flush on its behalf — and a removal without its recompute leaves the three geometry arrays describing the old row list, which draws every row below it at its neighbour's size.

list.title: module:HomeRows.resetLatestRowsRun
list.description:
resetLatestRowsRun: Return to a clean pre-run state — the orchestrator's node released (unobserved and stopped; its delivered result children go with it) and the drain cursor rewound.

Called before starting a run and from onDestroy. Named for the run rather than the task (the old cleanupLatestMediaTasks) because there is exactly one task now; what gets reset is the run's state around it.

list.title: module:HomeRows.resolveRowFill
list.description:
resolveRowFill: A row's data has landed — close its screen-load fill, then see whether that completed the visible span.

Resolves only a fill that is still OPEN. The same handlers serve every later load, and one can deliver a second time before Home settles — a return to Home mid-load refreshes, and onProgramsExpired re-fires On Now — so an unguarded resolve would raise the ledger's "unbalanced" warning on ordinary use, the warning that is meant to signal real drift.

list.title: module:HomeRows.rowStructureChanged
list.description:
rowStructureChanged: Announce that a row was added to or removed from m.top.content.

Outside a batch this recomputes immediately, so the single-row callers are unchanged.

Don't go looking for the deferred path — no caller reaches it. Every mid-run caller passes immediate (it MUST, or the geometry arrays stop describing the row list) and the rest only run while m.rowSizesBatching is already false, so m.rowSizesDirty is false at both batch boundaries and flushRowSizes() there is a no-op. What actually coalesces a run into one recompute is m.pendingRowRemovals.

m.rowSizesDirty is a FAIL-SAFE, not scaffolding for a future feature: a new mid-run caller that forgets immediate recomputes at the batch boundary instead of never. That turns the failure from wrong geometry — rows drawn at their neighbour's size, which produces no error, no log line and no timing change — into geometry that is merely late. Deleting it makes that mistake silent, which is the one failure mode in this file nothing else catches.

list.title: module:HomeRows.setRowItemSize
list.description:
setRowItemSize: Loops through all home sections and sets the correct item sizes, heights, and spacings per row. rowItemSize[i] = slot size [width, posterHeight] — determines focus ring dimensions (poster only, no text). rowHeights[i] = total row height: slot + 90px text area for standard rows; slot-only for library tiles. rowSpacings[i] = gap after each row before the next row label. Must be set for ALL rows because Roku ignores itemSpacing entirely once rowSpacings is assigned (even partially). Standard rows use 60px; My Media uses 78px to partially compensate for its absent text area.

Reach for rowStructureChanged() rather than this — it is the coalescing seam, and this is expensive enough (~85 ms early in a load, ~200 ms once every row is populated) that how many times it runs is the whole cost model.

list.title: module:HomeRows.startLatestMediaLoads
list.description:
startLatestMediaLoads: Hands the eligible libraries (in row order) to the orchestrator task.

Skips outright while a run is in flight, matching the isLoading* rule updateHomeRows() already applies to the other section loads: the running orchestrator is about to deliver fresh data, so restarting buys nothing and costs a cancel. Home is SUSPENDED rather than destroyed on navigation (onScreenHidden stops no tasks), so a Home revisit lands here mid-run routinely.

Every run gets a NEW node (see replaceTask in source/utils/tasks.bs): a stop-and-relaunch of the same node while its function still runs is sometimes silently ignored, and then no row would ever load.

list.title: module:HomeRows.startParallelLoads
list.description:
startParallelLoads: Fires off data tasks for sections that don't need library data. Library-dependent sections (library row, latestmedia) are handled in onLibrariesLoaded.

Launches in the user's layout order. The loop may call a helper more than once per refresh only if a type repeats; each helper's own isLoading* guard holds its section to one run, and states so at its launch — no-task-fanout follows these calls and fails the build otherwise.

list.title: module:HomeRows.updateBackdropForFocusedItem
list.description: Update backdrop to match currently focused item Handles all validation and edge cases Used by: onItemFocused observer and row update functions after replaceChild

list.title: module:HomeRows.updateHomeRows
list.description: updateHomeRows: Refresh data for all rows without tearing down the UI. Keeps existing row nodes in place to avoid focus disruption. As fresh data arrives, populateRowFromData updates row children in place.

list.title: module:IconButton.focusBorderOffset
list.description: Used for positioning calculations only (matches 6px border in 9-patch image); does NOT control actual border rendering

list.title: module:IconButton.layoutForIconSize
list.description: Size the backdrop around an icon of the given size, and center the icon in it.

list.title: module:IconButton.onLoadingChanged
list.description: onLoadingChanged: Swap icon for a spinner while loading. Does NOT set enabled=false — button stays focusable. OK blocking is handled by JRButtonGroup.

list.title: module:IconButton.spinnerSize
list.description: Used for positioning calculations only (matches 6px border in 9-patch image); does NOT control actual border rendering

list.title: module:IconButton.updateButtonPositioning
list.description: Updates button and text positioning based on ICON_BUTTON_TEXT_EXTENSION constant This centers button elements under the wider text label

list.title: module:ItemDetails.ESTIMATED_BUTTON_ROW_HEIGHT_PX
list.description: First-frame estimate for the button row's total rendered height. Used by anchorDateLabel() before boundingRect() has settled (it reports height=0 during initial render). Observed to land around 130 px for the typical 2-line-label icon button. A later renderTracking callback replaces this with the real measured height once layout completes.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.INFO_ROW_MIN_CUT_WIDTH
list.description: Narrowest a cut info-row item may be before it is dropped instead. Measured 2026-09-22 on a Roku Ultra: the row font averages 15.6px per character, so 160px is about ten characters, the shortest cut that still reads as a word or name rather than a stub.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.ITEM_DETAILS_EXTRAS_PADDING
list.description: Gap between bottom of itemInfoRows and top of extras pane when extras are open

list.title: module:ItemDetails.LOGO_MAX_DISPLAY_HEIGHT
list.description: Maximum display height for non-Person primary images — prevents portrait posters from extending above the metadata rows. Person photos are exempt because their info rows are short and don't reach the right edge where the photo sits.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.LOGO_MAX_DISPLAY_WIDTH
list.description: Maximum display width for the logo image — prevents very wide/flat logos from overlapping buttons

list.title: module:ItemDetails.LOGO_MIN_DISPLAY_HEIGHT
list.description: Minimum display height for the logo image — images too small are scaled up (aspect ratio preserved).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.LOGO_RIGHT_ANCHOR_X
list.description: Right edge the logo is anchored to (1920 * 0.95). Named because the button row's overflow cap is derived from it — see itemDetailsButtonCap(). If the logo moves and this stays behind, the cap silently stops describing the space it is meant to protect.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.LOGO_TEXT_CLEARANCE
list.description: The gap kept between the logo and any text beside or above it. Matches the block's own spacing between its title rows and the description.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.SetDefaultAudioTrack
list.description: SetDefaultAudioTrack: Auto-select the best audio stream based on user language prefs, storing the result on m.top.selectedAudioStreamIndex. The dropdown trigger label is refreshed separately by applyDropdown() using the same index.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.anchorDateLabel
list.description: anchorDateLabel: Derive the date label's Y position from the button group's position. Returns dateLabelY so callers (e.g. logo positioning) can use it without duplicating the math. Safe to call multiple times — idempotent, and safe to call BEFORE the button group has finished laying out: falls back to the group's fixed translation + ESTIMATED_BUTTON_ROW_HEIGHT_PX so the label never lands off-screen. A later renderTracking callback refines the position once the real rendered height is known.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.appendInfoRowItem
list.description: The rows fitInfoRow() cuts are built ONLY here, which is what lets it read a row as item, divider, item, ... by position: an item at every even index, a divider at every odd one. Append to those rows any other way and the fit misreads them.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.applyDropdown
list.description: applyDropdown: Push items + selection into a single TrackDropdown. Hides the slot when the track type isn't applicable (keeps layout order stable for the other two slots).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.applyVersionSelection
list.description:
applyVersionSelection: Point the screen at a version — the field, its streams and the track dropdowns, the Video row included (populateTrackDropdowns rebuilds it with its labels).

Shared by the viewer's pick and the automatic one (syncVersionSelectionToChoice) so the two cannot drift: a version carries its own audio and subtitle streams, and leaving those behind is what hands playback a stream index belonging to a different file.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.buildAudioDropdownItems
list.description: buildAudioDropdownItems: Convert the MediaStreams array into dropdown items for audio. Item id is the stringified server-side stream index, matching the ItemDetails contract that selectedAudioStreamIndex is an integer spanning all stream types.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.buildSubtitleDropdownItems
list.description:
buildSubtitleDropdownItems: Subtitle rows for the track cluster.

Two shapes are returned depending on whether the item actually has subtitle streams: No subtitle streams at all → [{ id:"-1", title:"None" }]. Rendered as a static non-interactive slot so the "Subtitles" title row still shows and the layout stays consistent across items. "None" (not "Off") because the user has no choice to make — subtitles simply don't exist on this item. One or more subtitle streams → [{ id:"-1", title:"Off" }, ...tracks]. The "Off" entry lets the user disable subtitles when tracks ARE present. id "-1" is the SubtitleSelection.NONE sentinel used by m.top.selectedSubtitleStreamIndex.

Titles come from remoteSubtitles.subtitleDropdownEntries() rather than straight from formatSubtitleDisplayTitle(), because language + codec + flags does not separate two English SRTs — measured on a 6-stream movie, this dropdown offered "English SUBRIP" three times, so a freshly downloaded subtitle was impossible to pick out from the built-in ones. The helper marks the downloaded ones and leaves the rest plain, which is the one question worth answering here.

Each item carries triggerTitle as well: the collapsed trigger is a narrow slot that already ellipsizes, and the marker is only meaningful beside the entries it distinguishes FROM, so the trigger shows the plain form.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.buildVideoDropdownItems
list.description: buildVideoDropdownItems: Convert MediaSources into dropdown items. "Video" here is the MediaSource, not a stream — it's the user-facing alternate-version selector. Every version is offered, whatever its VideoType: the version selected here (findBestVideoSource, the in-progress version) can be any of them, and so can the one the player offers and names, so a narrower list would leave the trigger naming a version that is not selected and label versions differently from the player. Labels come from versionLabels; the version in progress is marked in the open menu only (triggerTitle stays plain).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.canOfferManageSubtitles
list.description: canOfferManageSubtitles: Everything but the plugin — a Movie or Episode, and a user the server would let search. canSearchSubtitles() carries the permission rule and the measurements behind it.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.checkDeepLinkLaunch
list.description: See the call site in onScreenShown. A deep-link route carries ?deeplink= (open | play | shuffle | trailer | instantmix). We handle it once per distinct navigation (route.id), so a repeat cast of the item already showing still fires — the router reuses the active view on a same-path navigation and calls onRouteUpdate, which routes back through here with the new route.id — while a back-from-player resume (same route.id) does not re-fire. The ACTION (the sender's explicit intent — never inferred from the resolved item) is dispatched in dispatchDeepLinkAction. Fresh/loading -> flag for onDetailsLoaded (which also handles an invalid id -> error + Home); already-loaded resume -> dispatch once the router idles.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.checkDetailsLineBottoms
list.description: Debug builds: warn when detailsLineBottoms() disagrees with where the block really laid out its lines, since the text is fitted against the computed positions.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.checkSubtitleProviders
list.description:
checkSubtitleProviders: Ask the server whether a subtitle provider is installed, and insert Manage Subtitles if so.

Reached only when Home's session check has not answered yet. A failed check fails OPEN (the button is offered and the answer stays unknown, so the next screen asks again) — a transport error is not evidence the plugin is missing, and an empty search already explains itself.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.checkTrailerAvailability
list.description: Fetches whether the item has local trailers, to add/remove the Trailer button (onTrailerAvailableChanged reacts to the result). Render-thread promise — replaces the former trailerResultNode + onTrailerCheckDone observer (Phase-3b: a render-thread submitApiRequest + observeField flow → fetchAsync().then(); canonical in docs/dev/promises.md).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.clearVersionResumePositions
list.description: clearVersionResumePositions: Record that no version has a position any more. Marking any version watched marks every version played and clears every position on the server, so switching version afterwards must not bring Resume back from positions read earlier.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.closeMoreMenuBeforeRowChanges
list.description:
An open More menu describes a row that is about to change, so it closes with it. Cancelled HERE, at the top of the bracket, because at this instant nothing has detached yet: the More button is still in the row, so the dialog's returnFocusTo is still a live node and focus lands where the user left it. Cancelling after the re-derive would be a race against the very orphan this avoids.

No bookkeeping needed — cancelDialog resolves as externallyCancelled, and onMoreMenuResult already clears m.moreMenuDialog / m.overflowMenuIds and declines that result before it can act.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.closeSubtitlePanel
list.description: closeSubtitlePanel: Lower the panel and give the buttons back the remote.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createDividerNode
list.description: createDividerNode: Create a bullet divider node for separating info items

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createEndsAtNode
list.description: createEndsAtNode: Build an "Ends at" label and store it on m.endsAtNode for dynamic clock updates. Used by types with runTimeTicks-based durations.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createInfoLabel
list.description: createInfoLabel: Create a bold label node for the info rows

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createResumeButton
list.description: createResumeButton: A Resume button, not yet placed in the row.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createResumeLoadingButton
list.description: createResumeLoadingButton: The loading placeholder that holds the Resume slot while its data loads, recorded in m.resumeLoadingButton. Not yet placed in the row.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.createTimeLabel
list.description: createTimeLabel: Creates a time label with an optional lowercase am/pm suffix. In 24h mode returns a single label; in 12h mode appends the period to the time text.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.deferDeepLinkLaunchUntilIdle
list.description: Already-loaded view (an uncovered resume, or a same-path re-cast through onRouteUpdate): the content is there, but the hook runs MID-navigation, and the router rejects a navigateTo issued while a navigation is in progress (Router.brs _navigateTo). So wait for the navigation to settle (routerState -> NavigationEnd) before launching, otherwise startPlayFromDetail's navigateTo("/play") is swallowed (toast fires, but no player). Fresh mounts don't need this — they launch from onDetailsLoaded, which is already async / router-idle.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.detailsLineBottoms
list.description: Where each line of the text block will have its bottom edge once the block lays out, in screen space, at the block's resting position. Computed, not read: before the block's first layout its rows' boundingRect() reports nothing usable (measured 2026-09-22), and this has to run before the text first paints. The block is bottom-aligned; under the rows sit the description and the track spacer when each is in the layout, with the block's itemSpacings between them, and the rows stack with no spacing. A debug build checks this against the real layout in onItemDetailsRendered().

list.title: module:ItemDetails.detailsLineWidth
list.description: The width a line of text may use when its bottom edge sits at bottomY. Until the logo's place is known, it is taken to be the widest logo possible reaching the top of the screen, so every line stops short of the logo's leftmost POSSIBLE edge, which is safe for any logo. The left edge is read from the live translation, like the button row's geometry, so moving the block moves the budget with it.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.dispatchDeepLinkAction
list.description: Do exactly what the route's action asked, on the validated item. The action is the SENDER'S explicit intent — never inferred from the resolved item: open (and any unknown action) -> stay on the springboard (this view). Grid-container targets (library/folder/genre/studio/channel) never reach here — JRScene.onDeepLinkResolved diverts them to their grid. play -> QueueManager.launchItem (the DRY per-type play engine: video resumes its bookmark, Series smart-resumes, containers play, live watches, audio -> audio player, photo -> viewer). shuffle -> the same path the Shuffle button uses (onShuffleButtonPressed). trailer -> play this item's trailer(s). instantmix -> build an instant mix from the item (mirrors the instantMixButton).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.dispatchDetailButtonAction
list.description:
Run the action for a button ID. Reached two ways — a press on a visible button, and a row picked out of the "More" menu — so the overflow menu adds no second copy of this mapping.

Detail→detail nav (goToSeries / goToAlbum / goToArtist / goToChannel) navigates the router; playback buttons launch through the QueueManager / the play route; the rest run their render-thread action directly.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.displayCreditsNode
list.description: displayCreditsNode: Add a people credit ("Directed by ...") to the credits row

list.title: module:ItemDetails.displayDetailsNode
list.description: displayDetailsNode: Add a node to the second info row, prepending a bullet divider if needed

list.title: module:ItemDetails.displayInfoNode
list.description: displayInfoNode: Add a node to the info group, prepending a bullet divider if needed

list.title: module:ItemDetails.displayPeopleCredits
list.description:
The credits row, for ANY item type: whichever credits the item's own People carry, in the order creditRowKinds() lists them.

Driven by the item's own People rather than by its type, so a type the server starts crediting later needs no change here, and a type it doesn't credit shows nothing: 10.11 sends no Creator credits at all (12.0+ adds them to Series), and a Season carries Director credits on every version. Nothing is looked up from a parent — a Season or Episode shows only its own credits.

WHICH credits appear, in WHAT order, and how they read is people.bs's to own, beside the other PersonKind tables; this owns only the nodes. Same split as castCardSpecs() and transformPersonCard(). item.people is read exactly ONCE and handed over: it is a node array field, so every read copies the whole array. The row is fitted to the logo by fitInfoRow(), which drops a later credit rather than let it reach the logo.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.displayRatingNodes
list.description: displayRatingNodes: Community + critic rating chips shared across every rateable item type's Row 1. Both are gated behind uiMoviesShowRatings and only render when the value is present (> 0), so it's safe to call for any type — types without a rating from the server simply show nothing. Values are passed explicitly (rather than reading item.* directly) so callers that need a parent-series fallback (Season) can resolve the value first.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.endsAtDate
list.description: endsAtDate: Local time at which playback would finish if started right now.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.findSelectedSource
list.description: findSelectedSource: The MediaSource AA getStreamsForSelectedSource reads from, or invalid. Only a source carrying MediaStreams qualifies, including the fallback. The id is matched ignoring case, as playback start matches it (mediaSourceIndexForId).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.firstInteractiveDropdown
list.description: firstInteractiveDropdown: Returns the first visible, interactive TrackDropdown in left-to-right order, or invalid if none exist.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.fitInfoRow
list.description:
A LayoutGroup never clips, so an over-long row would run on into the logo. The item that crosses the budget is narrowed so the Label ellipsizes it, and what follows it is removed; see fitTextRow() for the rule. The row's own boundingRect() is NOT used: until the group has laid out it does not include its children's positions, so the widths are summed from the children instead.

Only a Label can be narrowed. A rating chip (an icon plus a label) that crosses the budget is dropped with the rest instead.

The cut is by character, not ellipsizeOnBoundary: on a Label that does not wrap, a single word too wide for the space renders as a bare "..." (#798).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.fitInfoRows
list.description: Cut the info rows to the space left of the logo. Runs after every rebuild, before the rows first paint: a Label's width is correct the moment its text is set. Row 1 has text that changes after the rebuild ("Ends at" each minute, a Playlist's item count), so those writes fit it again; a second fit of an already fitted row changes nothing.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.focusButtonGroupChild
list.description: focusButtonGroupChild: Focus the button at the current buttonFocused index directly

list.title: module:ItemDetails.focusInteractiveDropdown
list.description: focusInteractiveDropdown: Walks the given candidate list and focuses the first dropdown that is interactive AND visible. The candidate order encodes both direction and wrap behavior; the currently-focused dropdown is always last so the nav falls back to it if nothing else is interactive (effectively: stay put).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.formatEndsAtText
list.description:
formatEndsAtText: The one place the "Ends at" label text is built. Both the initial build and the per-minute refresh below go through here — they used to format independently, which meant any change to the rule had to be made twice or the label would render one way on open and another at the first clock tick.

formatDisambiguatedTime() owns the contextual am/pm rule and is shared with the playback OSD's own "Ends at", so one end time reads the same way on both screens.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.getButtonIndex
list.description: getButtonIndex: Find the index of a button by ID in the button group

list.title: module:ItemDetails.getHistory
list.description: getHistory: Format the air schedule/status string for a Series item Example output: "ABC" or "Fridays at 9:30 PM on NBC"

list.title: module:ItemDetails.getResumeButtonText
list.description: getResumeButtonText: Return "Resume S{n}E{n}" when season and episode numbers are known, otherwise fall back to plain "Resume".

list.title: module:ItemDetails.getStreamsForSelectedSource
list.description: getStreamsForSelectedSource: Pull the MediaStreams array from whichever media source matches m.top.selectedVideoStreamId. Falls back to mediaSources[0] when the selected id isn't found (e.g. first load before selection).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.holdDetailsText
list.description: Keep the text hidden until the logo's place is known, so it paints once, already fitted, instead of moving when the logo arrives. Only the text is held: the buttons, backdrop and logo paint as usual. textHoldTimer caps the wait.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.inProgressVersionId
list.description: inProgressVersionId: The version to mark as in progress in the Video dropdown, or "" — only a per-version server (m.versionResume set) keeps a position per version.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.insertButtonAtFront
list.description:
insertButtonAtFront: Put a Resume-slot button at the front of the row. It takes focus from Play, as a Resume button leads the row; any other focused button keeps focus, with its index shifted past the insert.

Real focus moves only when the row already owns it — an async insert must not steal focus from the extras row, e.g. after setupButtons() cleared and rebuilt the row.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.insertManageSubtitlesButton
list.description:
insertManageSubtitlesButton: Add the button to a row that is already built.

In setupButtons() order: after Trailer, before Delete / Refresh. Inside the unsplit/applyOverflow bracket, which keeps focus on the button the user is on when this lands to its left — see captureRowFocus() in buttonOverflow.bs.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.isPlayAllType
list.description: True for item types whose Play builds a multi-item queue via an API call (handled by QuickPlayTask, not the single-item path below).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.itemDetailsButtonCap
list.description: The cap for THIS row: it may not reach the logo's leftmost possible edge.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.itemDetailsRowGeometry
list.description:
The row's geometry, read from the live nodes rather than restated — so a change to the group's translation or spacing is picked up instead of drifting — and read in ONE place, so the cap and the overflow menu's anchor can never be derived from different numbers.

translation is taken as a SCREEN coordinate, which it is: buttonGrp is a direct child of this screen's root and the screen is mounted at the origin, the same thing updateItemDetailsAnimationTarget() already relies on when it compares a derived y against extrasLayout's absolute constants.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.itemOriginalLanguage
list.description: The shown item's OriginalLanguage (12.0+), for the "Original language" audio preference.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.launchQueueItemToPlay
list.description: Seed the queue with a single item and navigate to the play route. The router is idle (the user pressed a button on this settled view), so navigateTo won't hit the in-progress guard; PlayerHostView reads this queue on mount. :type/:id give the route a deep-link identity; the queue is the source of truth for what actually plays.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.layoutDetailsText
list.description: Fit the title, the description and all three info rows to the space the logo leaves. The rows must be freshly built (fitting only ever cuts); rebuildDetailsText() does both.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.loadFromRoute
list.description: Set itemType + itemId from a route's params. Setting itemId fires onItemIdChanged (the async loader). itemType is set first since the loader reads it.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.logoBoxFor
list.description: Where the logo is drawn for a bitmap of this size: right-aligned to LOGO_RIGHT_ANCHOR_X, its bottom 18px above the date label.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.logoBoxIntrudes
list.description: Whether a logo at newBox reaches into space text fitted to oldBox may be using.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.logoLeftmostX
list.description: The x where the logo's LEFTMOST possible edge sits: the right anchor less the widest the logo may be drawn. Everything left of the logo stops here, for any logo, so no measurement of the loaded image (which arrives after the text paints) is needed.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.manageResumeButton
list.description: manageResumeButton: Add, update or remove the Resume button from the selected version's resume position (non-Series types). While that position is still loading, the Resume slot shows a loading button — the same placeholder Series uses for its next-up fetch.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onAudioDropdownSelection
list.description: Audio dropdown selection: updates selectedAudioStreamIndex and re-seeds the subtitle auto-selection (Smart mode depends on which audio is playing). If the user has already manually overridden the subtitle, we leave it alone.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onButtonGrpRendered
list.description: onButtonGrpRendered: Fires after the render thread settles the button group layout. Re-anchors the date label and repositions the logo. The track dropdown cluster lives inside itemDetails LayoutGroup and is positioned automatically by the layout engine, so it doesn't need to be re-placed here.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onClockMinuteChanged
list.description: onClockMinuteChanged: Dynamically update "Ends At" time when overhang clock minute changes.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDeleteButtonPressed
list.description: Delete button. Confirm, then delete and leave the now-gone routed detail via the router. Standard showConfirmDialog helper (see onWatchedButtonPressed).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDestroy
list.description: onDestroy: Full teardown releasing all resources before component removal Called automatically via JRScreen.beforeViewClose when sgRouter permanently closes this view.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDetailNavButton
list.description: Single handler for every button on this detail's button group.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDetailsLoaded
list.description: Callback when initial item details metadata arrives from the task

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDropdownRequestDown
list.description: DOWN from any dropdown returns focus to the button group.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onDropdownRequestUp
list.description: Dropdown navigation: UP from any dropdown goes to description when in layout, else is consumed (no-op). parent-level UP handling reused so we don't have three identical handlers.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onExtrasContentReady
list.description:
onExtrasContentReady: the extras chain has run to its end — close the ledger's extras fill.

Reads the VALUE rather than treating the notification as the signal: the field is reset to false at the start of every chain, so half the callbacks here are the reset rather than the completion. (This is why it is not declared alwaysNotify — an alwaysNotify field would wake this on every re-set of false as well.)

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onExtrasItemSelected
list.description: Extras grid (cast / related / next-up) selection → navigate to its route, passing the rich node as context. Non-navigable items fall through to playback (quickPlayNode).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onExtrasTargetTranslationYChanged
list.description: onExtrasTargetTranslationYChanged: Animate the RowList translation to the new target. Fired early by onKeyEvent in ExtrasRowList (at key press) so the animation runs in parallel with the RowList's floatingFocus animation, and confirmed by onRowItemFocused after focus lands.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onFavoriteToggleFailed
list.description: Reverts the favorite button to its pre-press state and surfaces an error toast.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onFirstEpisodeLoaded
list.description: onFirstEpisodeLoaded: Start playback of first episode for Series Play button

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onItemIdChanged
list.description: Triggered when itemId is set (route load) — kicks off async data load

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onLogoLoadStatusChanged
list.description: onLogoLoadStatusChanged: Position logo to the right, with its bottom just above the date label. When the date label is hidden, anchors to where the date label would be. Images smaller than LOGO_MIN_DISPLAY_HEIGHT are scaled up while preserving aspect ratio, unless the logo is very wide/flat, in which case LOGO_MAX_DISPLAY_WIDTH takes precedence.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onLyricsLoaded
list.description: onLyricsLoaded: Show lyrics in the description area once the async fetch completes (Audio only)

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onMostRecentVersionLoaded
list.description: onMostRecentVersionLoaded: Record the server's answer and re-run the choice, unless the content has been reloaded since the request started.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onNextUpEpisodeChanged
list.description: nextUpEpisodeChanged: For Series — create/remove Resume button based on nextUpEpisode. On first load, replaces the LoadingButton placeholder from setupButtons(). On refresh, inserts/updates/removes the Resume button directly.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onPersonHasMediaChanged
list.description:
onPersonHasMediaChanged: Show Shuffle as soon as the person media chain finds media.

Only a TRUE is acted on here. Every run starts by resetting the field to false, so a false on its own is not an answer — acting on it removed Shuffle on every Refresh. The run's "no media" answer is read when the run finishes (onExtrasContentReady). alwaysNotify, so the run's final true is delivered even when an early true already was.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onPlaylistContentKindChanged
list.description:
onPlaylistContentKindChanged: Drives the Watched button and item-count label based on the confirmed content kind of the playlist ("video" / "audio" / "mixed" / "unknown"). Fires via alwaysNotify so it triggers even when the kind is unchanged (e.g. on refresh).

Watched button: only shown for "video" (has at least one video-type item). Label: "Tracks" only when positively confirmed "audio" (all items are Audio type). All other kinds — including "unknown" (load failure) and "mixed" — stay "Items".

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onQuickPlayLaunch
list.description: Forward a non-navigable extras selection to the playback launcher.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRecordButtonPressed
list.description: Record / cancel-record a Live TV program. Owns the RecordProgramTask on this render thread.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRefreshDetailsLoaded
list.description: Callback when refreshed item details metadata arrives

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRefreshExtrasData
list.description: onRefreshExtrasData: Reload all extras rows when the user explicitly presses Refresh.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRefreshItemDetailsData
list.description: Triggered by refreshItemDetailsData field toggle (return from playback, refresh button). Refreshes silently in the background — no spinner, no input blocking. The UI already has data from the initial load so the user can navigate freely.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRefreshResumeData
list.description: Triggered by refreshResumeData field toggle (watched toggle on Series). Re-fetches ONLY the next-up/resume episode — no full rebuild, no setupButtons(). The existing onNextUpEpisodeChanged() handles adding/removing/updating the resume button.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onRouteUpdate
list.description: The router reuses this view (no remount) when navigating to the SAME details path it's already showing — e.g. a cast of the item you're already on, after a player above it was popped. m.top.route is the new route by now, so re-run the deep-link check (its route.id dedup makes it a one-shot per navigation). Non-deep-link same-path updates are no-ops.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onScreenShown
list.description: onScreenShown: Callback when view is presented on screen

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onSeasonSeriesDataLoaded
list.description: onSeasonSeriesDataLoaded: Update Season info rows and logo with parent series metadata

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onSeriesResumeLoaded
list.description: onSeriesResumeLoaded: Set nextUpEpisode from seriesResume task result to show/hide the Resume button

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onServerResumePolicyLoaded
list.description: onServerResumePolicyLoaded: Store read thresholds for the session and redraw Resume.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onShuffleButtonPressed
list.description: Shuffle button. Routes by item type so new types can be added. PhotoAlbum launches a random slideshow; everything else resolves a randomized item set via GetShuffleItemsTask on the QueueManager.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onSubtitleDropdownSelection
list.description: Subtitle dropdown selection: marks user override so subsequent audio changes don't clobber the pick, then stores the new index. Action "-1" = Off.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onSubtitlesChanged
list.description:
onSubtitlesChanged: The server's subtitle set for this item changed.

This is NOT cosmetic. An added subtitle is inserted at stream index 0 and renumbers every other stream, so selectedAudioStreamIndex / selectedSubtitleStreamIndex — which are server stream indices, and which get handed to playback — are now pointing at the wrong tracks. Re-fetching the item is what makes them right again, and it also repopulates the subtitle dropdown so the newly added track is selectable the moment the panel closes.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onTextHoldTimeout
list.description: The logo's size has not arrived in time. The text is already fitted to the widest logo possible, so show it as it is; it is not refitted when the logo does arrive.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onTrackDropdownFocusChanged
list.description: onTrackDropdownFocusChanged: Observer wired to each TrackDropdown's focusedChild. Remembers the last dropdown that held focus so the UP-from-buttons handler can restore the previous slot on re-entry instead of always defaulting to video.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onTrackDropdownMenuOpenChanged
list.description: onTrackDropdownMenuOpenChanged: Observer wired to each TrackDropdown's menuOpen. Toggles the full-screen dimmer iff ANY dropdown's menu is currently open. The trackCluster (titles + triggers + the open menu itself) renders ABOVE the dimmer in XML sibling order, so only the screen content BEHIND the cluster dims — category titles and trigger labels stay full-brightness as the user's "you are here" cue while picking a track.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onVersionPositionLoaded
list.description: onVersionPositionLoaded: Record a fetched version position and redraw Resume, unless the content has been reloaded since the fetch started.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onVideoDropdownFocusExit
list.description: LEFT/RIGHT between dropdowns — each dropdown has its own exit handler so we know which slot we came from and can target the correct neighbor, skipping non-interactive slots.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onVideoDropdownSelection
list.description: Video dropdown selection fires when the user picks a different MediaSource (alternate version). We swap in the new source's streams, re-run audio auto-select, and rebuild the audio/subtitle dropdowns against the new source. Focus stays on the video dropdown.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onWatchChannelButtonPressed
list.description: Watch a Live TV channel (TvChannel detail, or the channel a Program airs on) — single-item launch via the play route.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onWatchedButtonPressed
list.description: Watched button. Movie/Episode toggle immediately; a Series confirms first (marking all episodes can affect hundreds). Uses the standard showConfirmDialog helper — the result arrives on the dialog node's own result field (no shared SceneManager state). On confirm we call toggleWatched(), which re-reads the button state to pick mark vs unmark.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onWatchedConfirmResponse
list.description: Series mark-all-watched confirmation result.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.onWatchedToggleFailed
list.description: Reverts the watched button to its pre-press state, clears the resume button's loading state, and surfaces an error toast.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.openMoreMenu
list.description: Open the overflow menu. The rows carry the same label and glyph the buttons were wearing, and resolve back to a button ID so the selection runs through onDetailNavButton's dispatch rather than a second copy of it.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.openSubtitlePanel
list.description:
openSubtitlePanel: Hand the panel everything it needs and raise it.

The panel targets the SELECTED VERSION, not the item. Jellyfin builds each MediaSource from its own item (source Id = that version's item id), and the subtitle endpoints act on the item in the URL: delete resolves the stream index on it and removes that stream's file, download saves beside its video. So the id, the path and the stream list must all come from the same source — an index from one version sent to another version's id can delete that version's media file. A single-version item is unaffected: its only source's Id is the item id.

Everything comes from data we already hold, so opening costs no round-trip. canDelete is resolved HERE rather than inside the panel so the panel stays free of policy knowledge (delete is admin-only on every server version).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.pickTrackDropdownFromButtons
list.description:
pickTrackDropdownFromButtons: Chooses which TrackDropdown to focus when UP is pressed from the button group. Ignores m.lastFocusedDropdown by design — UP-from-buttons should ALWAYS land on the dropdown visually above the currently focused button, not on wherever the user was last time. Each slot spans 2 buttons: slot 1 sits above buttons [0,1], slot 2 above [2,3], slot 3 above [4,5,...]. Widens outward to the nearest interactive slot if the preferred one is static/hidden.

CRITICAL: guards on m.trackCluster.visible — when the item type has no media tracks (Series/Person/BoxSet/etc.), the cluster is hidden but the individual dropdown nodes may still carry stale visible=true / isInteractive=true from a previously-loaded item. Without this guard, focus would move to an invisible stale dropdown when the user presses UP on those item types.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.pickTrackDropdownFromDescription
list.description: pickTrackDropdownFromDescription: Chooses which TrackDropdown to focus when DOWN is pressed from the description. Restores m.lastFocusedDropdown if still usable so the user returns to wherever they were before moving up. Falls back to the leftmost interactive dropdown (video → audio → subtitles) for the first-ever entry. Also guards on m.trackCluster.visible to match pickTrackDropdownFromButtons above.

list.title: module:ItemDetails.playFromDeepLink
list.description: Run the deep-link action on this already-loaded item in response to a runtime cast that landed while the user is ALREADY on its details (replayRoute.replayDeepLinkRuntime) — no navigation, so no Home flash and no re-mount. The router is idle here, so any navigateTo the action triggers succeeds directly (no NavigationEnd defer needed). action is the new cast's intent (the cached view's m.deepLinkAction is from its original mount and may be stale).

list.title: module:ItemDetails.rebuildDetailsText
list.description: Build the info rows again and fit them, for when what they are fitted to changes.
